package.description: A simple game server monitor and an administrative tool.

en-US.description: A simple game server monitor and an administrative tool.
en-US.longDescription: Game Server Watcher is a simple application that helps you to monitor the state of your favorite game servers and control remotely the servers of your own. It also has a buddy list and can notify you if a buddy joins any of servers.
en-US.name: Game Server Watcher
